note: Sample frames for the one-click design workflows (public/media/make/samples). They let each workflow open with a complete result before any AI call, and are the fallback when the daily FLUX allowance is used up.
model: Generated October 31, 2026 with Pollinations' free community API using its `flux` model (served as FLUX.1 [schnell], Apache-2.0), the same community engine the Image studio falls back to; not through chucksi.com's /api/shot.
processing: Bottom 8% cropped to remove the provider's corner mark, re-encoded as WebP quality 76. No reference images were supplied.
